title: Locally closed exceptional comparison under site comparison
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell
e p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $n\ge1$. Put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $s:S\hookrightarrow T$ be a locally closed immersion (a closed immersion followed by an open immersion) [def-weil-closed-immersion] of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Choose a factorization $s=v\circ c$, with $c:S\hookrightarrow V$ closed and $v:V\hookrightarrow T$ open [def-weil-open-immersion]. On the ordinary derived categories of constant-$A$ module sheaves on either small site $	au=\mathrm{et},\mathrm{proet}$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], put $F_	au=v_{	au,!}c_{	au,*}$ and $J_	au=Rc_	au^!v_	au^*$, using extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero, def-weil-extension-by-zero] and the ambient closed right adjoints [lem-exc-closed-ambient, lem-exc-proetale-closed-support]. Give $F_	au\dashv J_	au$ the pasted adjunction, with counit $\epsilon^	au$ [lem-cat-right-adjoint-composition]. Write $
u_W$ for the etale/pro-etale site comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], and $G_s=
u_S^*s^	imes R
u_{T,*}$ for the transported compact-support right adjoint [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image].

For $M\in D^b_c(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes], $J_{\mathrm{et}}M$ is bounded below. Composing open restriction comparison with the closed exceptional comparison gives a natural isomorphism
$$\gamma_M:
u_S^*J_{\mathrm{et}}M\xrightarrow{\sim}J_{\mathrm{proet}}
u_T^*M.$$
Let $\Delta_L:
u_T^*F_{\mathrm{et}}L\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{\mathrm{proet}}
u_S^*L$ be the composite of the canonical closed direct-image and open extension-by-zero comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate, lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison] for bounded-below etale $L$. Then
$$\epsilon^{\mathrm{proet}}_{
u_T^*M}\circ F_{\mathrm{proet}}(\gamma_M)\circ\Delta_{J_{\mathrm{et}}M}=
u_T^*(\epsilon^{\mathrm{et}}_M).$$
Under the counit-compatible identification $J_{\mathrm{et}}\cong s^	imes$, the value $J_{\mathrm{proet}}
u_T^*M$ and its adjunction maps on bounded-below etale-origin test objects identify with $G_s(
u_T^*M)$ and its comparison-class adjunction [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class]. The identification of $
u_S^*J_{\mathrm{et}}M$ with this transported value is $
u_S^*s^	imes(\eta_M)$, where $\eta_M:M\xrightarrow{\sim}R
u_{T,*}
u_T^*M$ is the site-comparison unit [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison]. The resulting comparisons are independent of the factorization through the canonical adjunction-composition identifications, and their units and counits are the pasted ones.

proof.text: Write $C_W=\nu_W^*$ and $e,p$ for the two sites. Apply [lem-sf-locally-closed-closure-adjoint-realization]. It gives the Noetherian hypotheses, $N=v_e^*M\in D^b_c$, $H=J_eM\in D^+$, the closure compactification and normalized $q_\tau:F_\tau\cong E_\tau$, with $J_e\cong s^\times$. All comparison inputs below are bounded below. Use [lem-sf-derived-immersion-comparison-normalization] for the derived open units/counits and the restriction normalization of the named closed mates.

proof.text:
Write $b:C_Vv_e^*\cong v_p^*C_T$, $o:C_Tv_{e,!}\cong v_{p,!}C_V$ and $\delta:C_Vc_{e,*}\cong c_{p,*}C_S$. Choose a bounded-below lift of $H$; transport the named Plus mate along its inclusion isomorphisms. Derived normalization identifies this with the termwise closed mate, independently of the lift. The closed theorem then supplies $\alpha_N:C_SRc_e^!N\cong Rc_p^!C_VN$ and $k^p c_{p,*}(\alpha_N)\delta_H=C_V(k^e_N)$. Define $\gamma_M=Rc_p^!(b_M)\alpha_N$ and $\Delta_L=v_{p,!}(\delta_L)o_{c_{e,*}L}$. They are natural isomorphisms with exactly the specified components. With pasted counits $\epsilon^\tau=e^\tau v_{\tau,!}(k^\tau)$, naturality and the closed equation give
$$\epsilon^pF_p(\gamma_M)\Delta_H=e^p v_{p,!}(b_M)v_{p,!}(C_Vk^e_N)o_{c_{e,*}H}=e^p v_{p,!}(b_M)o_N C_T(v_{e,!}k^e_N)=C_T(\epsilon^e_M).$$
The middle equality is naturality of $o$; the last is the normalized open counit equation. Thus $\gamma_M$ is the unique ambient transpose of $C_T(\epsilon^e_M)\Delta_H^{-1}$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-locally-closed-closure-comparison-square] to the normalized $q_\tau$. It gives $q_p\Delta=B C_T(q_e)$ for the named closure comparison $B$, and the commuting square for any second factorization. Now [lem-sf-locally-closed-relative-transpose-normalization] applies to the counit identity just proved. It identifies both Hom bijections by $\theta_M=\rho_M\gamma_M^{-1}$, where $\rho_M=C_Ss^\times(\eta_M)$, independently of every bounded-below etale-origin witness. Hence $\theta_M\gamma_M$ is the stated comparison unit and the defined units and counits agree.

proof.text: For a second factorization, conjugate the normalized left-adjoint maps to right-adjoint maps. Conjugation respects identities and composition [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate]; the preceding commuting square and uniqueness of the counit transpose force the $\gamma$ square. The natural formula $\theta\gamma=\rho$ forces its transported square. These are the canonical factorization identifications; their units and counits are the pasted ones [lem-cat-right-adjoint-composition, def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction].

Compared with the earlier a9a26737 head (cc FIX), there are two changes. First, the three closure nodes now say that bar S = SIm(s) is cut out by the largest quasi-coherent ideal, with the canonical inclusion and factor map. Because s is a quasi-compact immersion into the Noetherian T, that ideal is the raw kernel (Stacks 01R8) and S -> SIm(s) is open (01RG). This matches the definition's 'this kernel itself when g is quasi-compact' and keeps nonreduced images (k[e]/e^2 gives ideal (t^2)). Second, parent Step 2 carries the bounded-below-lift transport that the earlier review added as a fix, so the closed sibling's alpha_{N,e} and delta_{H,e} are read correctly, independent of the lift. The live item is still the base (split, 12 steps), so it is not superseded. None of the 39 cited ids or the item is in route-pivot-dropped, and nothing cites SGA. The repair note is met: the parent is 2560 characters in 4 steps, and there are 4 statement-only unsplit nodes of 2.5-4k characters each. The allocation keeps every old step: 2/3/8 go to derived-immersion normalization, 1/7 plus the bound part of 5 and the dimension bound of 10 go to closure realization, 9 plus the left part of 12 go to the closure square, 10/11 plus the transport part of 12 go to the relative transpose, and 4-6 plus the right part of 12 stay in the parent.
